description: proto8/cases 逐檔表（生成物，別手改）：tree 照資料夾巢狀，字串＝檔、物件＝夾，值＝那個檔檔頭的一句話；工具夾的 _entry／_tooldef.json／_metainfo.json 併成一格「名/」。要改說明去改檔頭，再跑 python3 wf/tools/index_gen.py --apply。

box-probe.check.json: Require every sandbox boundary check to pass.
box-probe.run.json: Probe the declared shell sandbox boundary.
box-probe.stdin.json: Try writes, network and host visibility using bash builtins.

addition.check.json: Require a byte-identical answer for the addition question.
addition.run.json: Run the fixed addition question through the math tool.
addition.stdin.json: Add two fixed integers for the smoke case.

multiplication.check.json: Require a byte-identical answer for the multiplication question.
multiplication.run.json: Run the fixed multiplication question through the math tool.
multiplication.stdin.json: Multiply two fixed integers for the smoke case.
